```{ojs}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
facets = [
  ["collection", "Collection"],
  ["product", "Reanalysis product"],
  ["frequency", "Frequency (reanalysis)"],
  ["level", "Level (reanalysis)"],
  ["activity_id", "Activity"],
  ["institution_id", "Institution"],
  ["source_id", "Source (model)"],
  ["experiment_id", "Experiment"],
  ["member_id", "Member"],
  ["table_id", "Table"],
  ["variable_id", "Variable"],
  ["grid_label", "Grid"],
  ["version", "Version"]
]
uniq = (k) => [...new Set(summary.map((d) => d[k]).filter((v) => v != null))].sort()
// Filters and search text from the page URL, read once on load.
urlState = {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const known = new Map(facets.map(([k]) => [k, new Set(uniq(k))]));
  const init = {};
  const dropped = [];
  for (const [k, v] of params) {
    if (k === "search") continue;
    if (known.get(k)?.has(v)) (init[k] ??= []).push(v);
    else dropped.push(`${k}=${v}`);
  }
  // Not "q": Quarto's site search reads and removes ?q= on page load.
  return {init, q: params.get("search") ?? "", dropped};
}
// One Tom Select multi-select that behaves as an Observable input:
// .value is the picked values, an "input" event fires on change, .ts is the instance.
facetSelect = (k, label, values, initial = []) => {
  const id = `facet-${k}`;
  const select = html`<select id=${id} multiple></select>`;
  const root = html`<div class="facet-select"><label class="form-label" for=${id}>${label}</label>${select}</div>`;
  root.ts = new TomSelect(select, {
    options: values.map((v) => ({value: v, text: v, count: null})),
    items: initial,
    plugins: {remove_button: {title: "Remove"}, clear_button: {title: "Clear"}},
    maxOptions: null,
    placeholder: "Any",
    hidePlaceholder: false,
    closeAfterSelect: false,
    render: {
      option: (d, esc) =>
        `<div class="${d.count === 0 ? "ts-zero" : ""}">${esc(d.text)}` +
        `${d.count == null ? "" : ` <span class="ts-count">(${d.count.toLocaleString()})</span>`}</div>`,
      item: (d, esc) => `<div>${esc(d.text)}</div>`
    },
    onChange: () => root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  });
  // Keep Tom Select's own typing/change events from reaching the page.
  for (const type of ["input", "change"]) {
    root.addEventListener(type, (e) => { if (e.target !== root) e.stopPropagation(); });
  }
  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {get: () => root.ts.getValue()});
  return root;
}
viewof filters = {
  const widgets = Object.fromEntries(
    facets.map(([k, label]) => [k, facetSelect(k, label, uniq(k), urlState.init[k] ?? [])])
  );
  const clear = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Clear all filters</button>`;
  const copy = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Copy link to this search</button>`;
  const root = html`<div class="facet-filters">
    <p class="small text-body-secondary mb-2">Type or pick values; × removes one. No values means any.</p>
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">${clear}${copy}</div>
    ${Object.values(widgets)}
  </div>`;
  root.widgets = widgets;
  clear.onclick = () => {
    for (const w of Object.values(widgets)) w.ts.clear(true);
    root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  copy.onclick = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href).then(() => {
    copy.textContent = "Link copied";
    setTimeout(() => (copy.textContent = "Copy link to this search"), 1500);
  });
  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => Object.fromEntries(facets.map(([k]) => [k, widgets[k].value]))
  });
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
base = arq.from(summary)
// Rows matching every facet's picked values except `skip`'s.
matching = (skip) => {
  const active = facets.filter(([k]) => k !== skip && filters[k].length > 0);
  if (active.length === 0) return base;
  const sets = active.map(([k]) => [k, new Set(filters[k])]);
  return base.filter(arq.escape((d) => sets.every(([k, s]) => s.has(d[k]))));
}
// Faceted-search counts: for each facet, the number of results each value
// would give, given the other facets' picks.
counts = Object.fromEntries(
  facets.map(([k]) => [
    k,
    new Map(matching(k).groupby(k).count().objects().map((r) => [r[k], r.count]))
  ])
)
filtered = matching(null).objects()
// Update option labels on the existing widgets.
updateCounts = {
  for (const [k] of facets) {
    const ts = (viewof filters).widgets[k].ts;
    for (const v of uniq(k)) {
      const n = counts[k].get(v) ?? 0;
      if (ts.options[v]?.count !== n) ts.updateOption(v, {value: v, text: v, count: n});
    }
    ts.refreshOptions(false);
  }
  return true;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof searchBox = Inputs.search(summary, {
  query: urlState.q,
  placeholder: "Search within results (any column)",
  label: "Search",
  width: 380,
  format: () => ""
})
searchText = (searchBox, (viewof searchBox).querySelector("input").value)
searched = searchText === ""
  ? filtered
  : ((ids) => filtered.filter((d) => ids.has(d.dataset_id)))(new Set(searchBox.map((d) => d.dataset_id)))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Save the filters and search text in the page URL (no new history entries).
saveUrl = {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k] of facets) for (const v of filters[k]) p.append(k, v);
  if (searchText) p.set("search", searchText);
  const s = p.toString();
  history.replaceState(history.state, "", `${location.pathname}${s ? `?${s}` : ""}${location.hash}`);
  return s;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
reportUrl = (d) => {
  const u = new URL(`https://github.com/${config.github_repo}/issues/new`);
  u.searchParams.set("template", "report-problem.yml");
  u.searchParams.set("title", `[Problem]: ${d.dataset_id}`);
  u.searchParams.set("dataset_id", d.dataset_id);
  u.searchParams.set("path", d.relative_path);
  return u.href;
}
// One Tabulator that behaves as an Observable input: .value is the selected
// rows, an "input" event fires on selection change, .table is the instance.
viewof selected = {
  const holder = html`<div class="browse-table"></div>`;
  const csv = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Download table (CSV)</button>`;
  const status = html`<span class="small text-body-secondary"></span>`;
  const root = html`<div>
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">${status}${csv}</div>
    ${holder}
  </div>`;
  const col = (field, title, extra = {}) => ({field, title, ...extra});
  const table = new Tabulator(holder, {
    data: [],
    index: "dataset_id",
    layout: "fitDataStretch",
    maxHeight: "520px",
    renderVertical: "virtual",
    selectableRows: true,
    selectableRowsRangeMode: "click",
    placeholder: "No matching datasets",
    columnDefaults: {resizable: true, headerSort: true},
    columns: [
      {formatter: "rowSelection", titleFormatter: "rowSelection", hozAlign: "center",
       headerSort: false, resizable: false, width: 44, frozen: true},
      col("source_id", "source"),
      col("product", "product"),
      col("experiment_id", "experiment"),
      col("member_id", "member"),
      col("table_id", "table"),
      col("frequency", "freq"),
      col("level", "level"),
      col("variable_id", "variable"),
      col("grid_label", "grid"),
      col("version", "version"),
      col("n_files", "files", {hozAlign: "right", sorter: "number"}),
      col("size_gb", "GB", {hozAlign: "right", sorter: "number"}),
      col("time_start", "start"),
      col("time_end", "end"),
      col("relative_path", "download", {
        frozen: true, headerSort: false, titleDownload: "relative_path",
        formatter: (cell) => {
          const d = cell.getRow().getData();
          const a = Object.assign(document.createElement("a"), {
            href: `dataset.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(d.dataset_id)}`, textContent: "Files",
            title: `Download links for the ${d.n_files} file(s) in ${d.dataset_id}`
          });
          a.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
          return a;
        }
      }),
      col("dataset_id", "report", {
        frozen: true, headerSort: false, titleDownload: "dataset_id",
        formatter: (cell) => {
          const d = cell.getRow().getData();
          const a = Object.assign(document.createElement("a"), {
            href: reportUrl(d), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener", textContent: "Report",
            title: `Report a problem with ${d.dataset_id}`
          });
          a.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
          return a;
        }
      })
    ]
  });
  root.table = table;
  root.status = status;
  root.ready = new Promise((resolve) => table.on("tableBuilt", resolve));
  root.value = [];
  table.on("rowSelectionChanged", (data) => {
    root.value = data;
    root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  });
  csv.onclick = () => table.download("csv", "cmip_datasets.csv");
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Show the current results; drop any selection so Get data never uses rows
// that are no longer shown.
updateTable = {
  const view = viewof selected;
  await view.ready;
  view.table.deselectRow();
  await view.table.replaceData(searched);
  view.status.textContent = `${searched.length.toLocaleString()} matching dataset(s)`;
  return searched.length;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
chosen = selected.length > 0 ? selected : searched
maxSnippet = 50
maxFiles = config.wget_max_files
isPlaceholder = (v) => !v || /_TBD$/.test(v)
internal = config.audience === "internal"
copyBlock = (text, lang = "") => {
  const pre = html`<pre class="sourceCode ${lang}"><code>${text}</code></pre>`;
  const btn = html`<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary mb-2">Copy</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    btn.textContent = "Copied";
    setTimeout(() => (btn.textContent = "Copy"), 1500);
  });
  return html`<div class="get-data-block">${btn}${pre}</div>`;
}
html`<h2>Get data</h2>
<p>${chosen.length.toLocaleString()} dataset(s)
${selected.length > 0 ? "selected" : "matching (no rows picked)"},
${d3.sum(chosen, (d) => d.n_files).toLocaleString()} files,
${d3.sum(chosen, (d) => d.size_gb).toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1})} GB.
See the <a href="access.html">access page</a> for which method to use.</p>`
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Python (intake-esm)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pythonSnippet = {
  const ids = chosen.slice(0, maxSnippet).map((d) => d.dataset_id);
  const swap = internal
    ? ""
    : `\n# Outside VAST: read over HTTPS instead of ${config.vast_prefix}\n` +
      `cat.df["path"] = cat.df["path"].str.replace(\n` +
      `    "${config.vast_prefix}", "${config.https_prefix}", regex=False\n)\n`;
  return `import intake

cat = intake.open_esm_datastore("${config.catalog_path}")
${swap}
keys = [
${ids.map((k) => `    "${k}",`).join("\n")}
]
dsets = {k: cat[k].to_dask() for k in keys}`;
}
html`${chosen.length > maxSnippet
  ? html`<p><em>Showing the first ${maxSnippet} of ${chosen.length} datasets. Narrow the filters or pick rows.</em></p>`
  : ""}
${copyBlock(pythonSnippet, "python")}
${isPlaceholder(config.catalog_path) ? html`<p><em>The catalog path is not final yet (placeholder).</em></p>` : ""}`
```

## HTTPS download

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
wgetList = {
  // Fetch the file-list shards needed for the chosen datasets, stopping
  // once maxFiles names have been collected.
  const take = [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const d of chosen) {
    if (n >= maxFiles) break;
    take.push(d);
    n += d.n_files;
  }
  const shards = [...new Set(take.map((d) => d.file_list))];
  const lists = Object.assign(
    {},
    ...(await Promise.all(shards.map((s) => fetch(`data/${s}`).then((r) => r.json()))))
  );
  const urls = take.flatMap((d) =>
    (lists[d.dataset_id] ?? []).map((f) => `${config.https_prefix}/${d.relative_path}/${f}`)
  );
  const total = d3.sum(chosen, (d) => d.n_files);
  return {urls: urls.slice(0, maxFiles), total};
}
html`${isPlaceholder(config.https_prefix)
  ? html`<p><em>HTTPS downloads are not available yet; the URL prefix below is a placeholder.</em></p>`
  : ""}
${wgetList.total > maxFiles
  ? html`<p><em>List capped at ${maxFiles} of ${wgetList.total.toLocaleString()} files.
    For large requests use the cluster or SMB share${config.globus_url ? html`, or <a href="${config.globus_url}">Globus</a>` : ""}
    (see the <a href="download-guide.html">download guide</a>).</em></p>`
  : ""}
<p>Save as <code>urls.txt</code>, then run:</p>
${copyBlock("wget --continue --force-directories --no-host-directories -i urls.txt", "bash")}
${DOM.download(new Blob([wgetList.urls.join("\n") + "\n"], {type: "text/plain"}), "urls.txt", "Download urls.txt")}
${copyBlock(wgetList.urls.join("\n"))}`
```
